name: cursor-sdk-metal
summary: Cursor SDK — TypeScript (@cursor/sdk) and Python (cursor-sdk). Agent.create() + agent.send() for durable multi-turn. Agent.prompt() for one-shot. Agent.resume() for cross-process. Local (cwd on caller machine) or Cloud (Cursor-hosted VM, auto PR). MCP servers passed inline on create or send. Streaming via run.messages() / run.stream(). model='composer-2.5' default. CURSOR_API_KEY for auth. CursorAgentError for startup failures vs result.status='error' for run failures.

key_concepts.mcp_in_sdk: Pass mcp_servers dict to Agent.create or agent.send. HTTP (url) or stdio (command+args). Not persisted across resume.
key_concepts.streaming: run.messages() yields SDKMessage. run.text() blocks and returns final text. run.wait() required.
key_concepts.disposal: with Agent.create() as agent: (Python) or await using (TS). Always dispose.
key_concepts.model_selection: Cursor.models.list() for available models. composer-2.5 is default.
key_concepts.cloud_pr: auto_create_pr=True to auto-open PR from cloud agent
key_concepts.mcp_apps: Tools can return interactive UI (MCP Apps extension)

gaia_integration.gaia_agent_py: gaia-agent.py — Cursor SDK code agent. Carries squirrel (20 tools) + gaia (18 organs) MCP servers. Local or cloud. Interactive or one-shot.
